description: Find out why a form, view, web resource, workflow or cloud flow deployed with a managed solution does not show in the target environment: unpublished changes in Dev, component missing from the solution, unmanaged layers, other managed solutions on top, staged upgrades, flows turned off or without connections, inactive forms and views, app membership, form roles and order. Compares Dev and Target and offers confirmed fixes. Created by Ankit Rana.
releaseNotes: 1.5.2: The unmanaged-layer finding shows when the layer was last changed (your local time) and whether that is older or newer than the last deployment. 1.5.1: Beta labels removed. 1.5.0: Four new component types (beta): environment variable, connection reference, plug-in step (with an Enable fix) and plug-in assembly, in both Check one item and Compare whole solution; the headline now prefers a real cause over the Target vs Dev symptom. 1.4.1: The start screen also explains Compare whole solution. 1.4.0: New Compare whole solution mode: pick a solution and see every form, view, site map, ribbon, process / flow and web resource compared between Dev and Target (red = different or missing, orange = state differs such as a flow off in Target, not published in Dev, or only in Target), with full details per component, a Diagnose this component button and HTML / CSV / text export. 1.3.2: The unmanaged-layer finding now lists what the unmanaged layer changed (compared with the managed layer below it, or with Dev when Dataverse stores no content). 1.3.1: The start screen lists what the tool can check; every health row shows exactly what was checked (the tests that passed, with counts). 1.3.0: New component types Site map and Ribbon (command bar, beta) with compare, layers and a health check (is it corrupted?); the four tiles are replaced by a grouped Component type dropdown. 1.2.1: Simpler screen: three steps on the left, the answer first on the right, problems and warnings as cards, passed checks collapsed; the evidence can be read in a plain-words User view or the original Developer view. 1.1.1: New form health check: tells you whether a form is really corrupted (damaged XML, duplicate ids), only has broken references (missing fields, scripts, views, quick view forms, custom controls), or is healthy; also finds forms recreated with the same name but a different id. 1.0.0: First public release. Diagnoses why a change deployed with a managed solution does not show in the target environment, for forms, views, web resources and processes (classic workflows, business rules, actions, cloud flows). Dev vs Target compare, solution layers, publish state, solution membership, flow state and connection references; confirmed fixes that show the user they run as; HTML/CSV/text reports.
summary: Why does my deployed change not show? Diagnose it, fix it, or compare a whole solution between Dev and Target: forms, views, site maps, ribbons, web resources, flows, environment variables, connection references and plug-ins.
title: Deployment Doctor
